image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a car wheel mounted on a vehicle. The wheel features a complex multi-spoke alloy rim with a two-tone finish (polished silver faces and black recessed areas). A black rubber tire surrounds the rim, showing visible tread blocks and sidewall texture. The central hub contains a dark center cap with a logo and surrounding lug nuts. The wheel is resting on green grass, with a portion of the car's fender visible at the top.
